title: DESIGN.md is the sole design authority; Blueprint presents it
context: The design rules lived in docs/design-system.md, the Blueprint design-system section and the landing decision records, and they drifted apart. Contrast and button-size defects went unnoticed because no one document owned the tokens.
decision: A root DESIGN.md in the impeccable format is the only authority for the design system. docs/design-system.md is migrated into it and deleted; the Blueprint design-system section becomes a presentation layer over it. .impeccable/design.json is a committed, generated artefact (the sidecar carrying values such as motion durations and easings). Apple HIG is adopted as a guideline source and applied gradually, as pages are redesigned. Motion rules live in DESIGN.md's Do's and Don'ts (transform and opacity only, honour reduced motion) with duration and easing values in the sidecar; landing motion tokens stay landing-scoped; there is no forced-dark-section rule.

alternatives.option: Keep docs/design-system.md and the Blueprint section as parallel sources
alternatives.reason: Two editable sources drift; the Blueprint page already defers to the doc when they disagree.

alternatives.option: Make the Blueprint design-system section the authority
alternatives.reason: It is a rendered site, not a format that design tooling and agents read directly.

consequences: A later shard migrates the document and removes docs/design-system.md.
The sidecar is regenerated from DESIGN.md and committed, so a stale sidecar is a review finding.
HIG rules reach a page only when that page is redesigned, so the app stays mixed for a while.
revisitTriggers: HIG adoption proves too broad to apply page by page.
